text:
[issue by khaleeesy]
### Minecraft Version

1.21.1 (LTS)

### Mod Loader

Fabric

### Describe the Issue

I updated my game version from 1.21 to 1.21.1 with all mods. Everything works except for the waystones. Below is the crash report. For some reason it works fine in creative mode, but not in survival.

[crash-2025-09-24_12.21.49-client.txt](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/22511447/crash-2025-09-24_12.21.49-client.txt)

### Logs

[crash-2025-09-24_12.21.49-client.txt](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/22511486/crash-2025-09-24_12.21.49-client.txt)

[comment by BlayTheNinth (member)]
> at knot//net.inventive_mods.inventive_inventory.util.InteractionHandler.getStackFromSlot(InteractionHandler.java:24)

This crash is coming  from Inventive Inventory, not Waystones.

[comment by khaleeesy (none)]
Thank you so much! Removing Inventive Inventory fixed the problem!
